market_context: Monday's Nvidia-led rally was huge: Jensen Huang returned as CEO, NVDA rose 31%, the S&P 500 rose 4.7% and the Nasdaq rose 6.5%. Pre-market on Tuesday it is partly reversing. S&P futures are down about 1.2%, Nasdaq futures are down about 2%, and NVDA is down about 5%. The VIX is near 30, the 10-year yield is 4.89%, and a December Fed rate hike is priced at about 95%. Hot October PCE data is due Wednesday, tariff increases are reportedly being prepared, and Dell reports after the close.

predictions.reasoning: SPY was about $712 pre-market (-1.4%) and S&P futures were down about 1.2%, as traders gave back part of the best session since April 2025. With a Fed hike nearly fully priced, a hot PCE print due Wednesday, and reported tariff hikes, I expect the post-rally fade to hold through the close.

QQQ was about $635 pre-market (-2.4%) and Nasdaq futures were down about 2% after a 7% one-day jump. Questions about AI financing and profitability remain unresolved, and Micron, AMD and Broadcom are all lower.

NVDA was down about 5% pre-market after a 31% one-day surge that added roughly $950B in market value. Profit-taking, governance worries and a planned Senate testimony in December argue for continued giving-back, though dip buyers could limit the drop.
Bitcoin is trading in line with tech stocks and reached $64.2K on Monday before reversing to about $60K. Risk assets are weaker, the dollar is near 20-month highs, and a Fed hike is expected.
